name: Kingdoms and Ruins
description:
[NEW] Kingdoms & Ruins 1.19

BEDROCK - JAVA CROSSPLAY

Kingdoms and Ruins is aiming to build a Towny Server with a wide range of features. Our server includes the following perks:

💰 Economy: Custom NPC shops, Player shops, & Server shops!

🥇 Ranks: Begin your adventure as a Peasant, and climb your way up the rank hierarchy! Rank-up to unlock access to new perks.

🎮 Bedrock-Java Cross-play: Users can join the server from Pocket Edition, Java Edition, Windows 10 Edition, Xbox, PlayStation, and the Nintendo Switch.

🏗️ Creative Mode: Enter a creative PlotWorld with /creative

🏡 Towny Survival Mode: Claim some land and build your very own community from the ground up!

⚔️ RPG Elements: Everything you do earns you experience. Mine, Dig, Run, Eat - Level up, Increase your stats, & Unlock OP abilities

🎯 Minigames: Fight your way to victory through hordes of mobs in the Mob Arena, Challenge other players to PVP in the Arena, or race for the fastest Parkour time for big rewards!
